outlet: Kittitas County Code, Title 2 (Administration and Personnel)
notes: KCC 2.08.010 (Upper - Lower justice court districts designated): two district court districts by voting precinct, the Upper Kittitas County District Court (Hyak, Easton, Mountain, Ronald, all Roslyn precincts, Roslyn Outlying, all Cle Elum precincts, Kachess, South Cle Elum, Peoh Point, Swauk, Teanaway, Westside) and the Lower Kittitas County District Court (the remaining precincts: Ellensburg, Kittitas, Thorp, Vantage and the rest); Ord. 2011-014. KCC 2.08.020: one judge elected in each district.
